notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.2 ROGUE+DIVINE. PRC PnP familiar is excluded from XAI attach/selection and no longer consumes the intended real companion allowance. Fresh 410x535 panel geometry. Capability-gated buttons: Rage, Parry, Turn Undead, spells. Cleric/druid/wizard/paladin/ranger prepared spell slots are listed with GetMemorizedSpell* APIs and counted correctly. Prebuff includes low-level divine buffs and never auto-summons a familiar. Rogue utility priorities: combat/survival always wins; trap detection/disarm and lock work only with no nearby hostiles and within 10m/8m of the player; default TRAPS and LOCKS are AFTER COMBAT with cycles OFF/AFTER/AUTO; stealth is separately toggleable and is forcibly dropped on danger or utility actions. Auto Turn Undead is used only when worthwhile; auto Parry is used only under heavy melee pressure/low HP. Internal PREBUFF_FULL telemetry is rendered in Russian.
